passages.text: For a sustained retrieval p95 above 900 ms, first compare query volume, error rate, and shard memory. If volume is stable and one shard exceeds 85% memory, inspect compaction and cache eviction before scaling the whole cluster.

Background index compaction can contend with retrieval when a shard has less than 15% free memory. Pause the compaction job, allow caches to recover for 20 minutes, then compare p50 and p95. Do not restart all nodes at once.

Tell the customer what users experienced, the current mitigation, and the next checkpoint. Label suspected causes as hypotheses until correlated with logs. Never promise a resolution time before the mitigation has been observed under representative load.

The standard regulated topology uses three retrieval nodes across separate failure domains, a dedicated ingestion worker, and an external PostgreSQL metadata store. Customer traffic enters through their managed gateway.
Private-cloud deployments export aggregate service metrics to Beacon through an outbound-only collector. Document content, search queries, and result payloads never leave the customer environment.

Version 4.18.2 reduces average compaction duration for newly created indexes. Existing large shards can temporarily use more memory during their first post-upgrade compaction. Schedule that operation outside peak query periods.
On clusters with shards above 1.5 TB, compaction concurrency must remain at one until the shard has completed its first 4.18.2 cycle.

documents.title: Customer incident severity and communication policy

passages.text: A production degradation affecting a primary customer workflow with no acceptable workaround is Priority 1. Provide an update at least every 60 minutes while actively mitigating.
Drafts generated from internal investigation notes require a human owner to verify customer-safe wording before they are posted to an external channel.

Northwind’s 2026 target is to reduce analyst time spent locating approved policy material by 30%. The executive sponsor will assess adoption, answer quality, and stable performance at the October renewal review.
Summit will deliver a capacity review before August 7. Northwind will confirm its Q4 ingestion forecast. Both teams will agree on a latency service-level objective before renewal planning.
